categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent measurements, and encumbrance information. The content focuses on land ownership registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
